youtube.title: The Demoness Rama Didn't Want to Kill | Ramayana Ep 5
youtube.description:
Rama's first enemy had the strength of a thousand elephants. And he did not want to kill her. 🏹

Vishvamitra led the young princes Rama and Lakshmana across the Ganga into a dreadful forest, once the rich lands of Malada and Karusha, now laid waste by the yakshi Tataka. Her strength was a boon from Brahma; her fury came from sage Agastya's curse after she and her son Maricha attacked him. Vishvamitra told Rama that protecting the people is a ruler's eternal duty. Yet when she charged, Rama told Lakshmana he could not kill a woman and would only stop her. Only when she vanished into illusion, raining rocks as dusk approached, did Rama aim by sound alone.

📜 On screen (Valmiki Ramayana 1.25.18):
"Nṛśaṃsam anṛśaṃsaṃ vā prajārakṣaṇakāraṇāt, pātakaṃ vā sadoṣaṃ vā kartavyaṃ rakṣatā sadā"
(Cruel or not, sinful or flawed, one who protects must always act to protect the people.)

instagram.caption:
Shri Ram's first foe: a demoness he didn't want to kill

Across the Ganga lay a dreadful forest, once the rich land of Malada and Karusha, laid waste by the yakshi Tataka.
Brahma's boon gave her the strength of a thousand elephants; sage Agastya's curse made her a man-eating rakshasi.
Vishvamitra said a protector must act for the people. Still Rama told Lakshmana: she is a woman, I will only stop her.
When she vanished into illusion as dusk neared, Rama aimed by sound alone, and one arrow brought her down.

📜 Valmiki Ramayana 1.25.18 · RAMAYANA — The Epic in Chalk · Ep 5
